description: Run the existing Portfolio API for up to 50 supplied stock holdings with shares and optional per-share cost basis. Requires portfolio consent and existing service access/API allowance. Does not save a portfolio, place orders or synchronize a broker. Saved option holdings can be read with read_portfolio; this API accepts the existing stock-holdings contract. API reference: https://www.signaldock.app/developers/openapi.json.

path.description: Object keys or array indices from the returned field directory. Empty selects the root.

name: analyze_portfolio
title: Analyze supplied portfolio holdings
